categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three business segments: non-ferrous metal materials, filtration materials, and environmental governance, which includes flue gas treatment engineering, hazardous waste disposal, urban and rural sanitation integration, and sewage treatment. These segments align with the environmental protection industry and focus on resource recycling and pollution control.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes core technologies in high-temperature filtration materials, catalytic denitrification catalysts, and hazardous waste resource recovery. It employs advanced manufacturing processes for filtration materials and integrates engineering solutions for environmental governance projects. The company also invests in R&D centers and collaborates with universities to enhance innovation capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industries such as power generation, cement kilns, steel, coal chemical, petrochemical, pharmaceutical, and municipal sanitation sectors. The company serves domestic markets predominantly, with some export sales, providing products and services for pollution control and resource recycling in heavy industries and urban environmental management.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates within China, with business activities concentrated in regions such as Jiangxi, Jiangsu, Shaanxi, Ningxia, Xinjiang, and Beijing. It also has minor international exposure through subsidiaries and export sales. The headquarters and major facilities are located in Xiamen, Fujian Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection supply chain, producing filtration materials and providing environmental engineering services. It also engages in hazardous waste treatment and resource recycling, positioning itself as an integrated environmental solutions provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing filtration material technologies, expanding hazardous waste resource utilization, and enhancing environmental governance services. The company focuses on innovation in high-temperature filter media, catalytic denitrification, and integrated environmental solutions, supported by a national enterprise technology center and collaborations with academic institutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of filtration materials, non-ferrous metal materials, environmental engineering projects, hazardous waste disposal services, and urban sanitation services. The company recognizes revenue upon transfer of control of goods or completion of services, with contracts spanning multiple years in some cases.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic player in high-temperature filtration materials and environmental engineering services, with competitive advantages in technology and integrated service offerings. It faces intense competition in hazardous waste and filtration markets but leverages its technical expertise and government policy alignment to maintain market presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately 515 million RMB, a decline of nearly 49% from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about 160 million RMB. The company experienced operational challenges due to policy-driven production restrictions and market competition, resulting in reduced profitability and cash flow pressures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced filtration materials as critical components ('heart' of filtration equipment) with superior performance in high-temperature and specialized industrial applications. Its integrated environmental governance services and hazardous waste resource recycling capabilities provide comprehensive solutions aligned with national environmental policies, differentiating it from competitors.
